summary: The patch fixes CDC commit log reading stalling after restart or on zero-padded segments. It does this by setting BufferingCommitLogReader.position to the start marker when resuming, to log.maxOffset() on LEGACY_END_OF_SEGMENT_MARKER, and to log.maxOffset() when the section loop finishes normally. It also stops overwriting position after an early termination. Checklists applied: shallow-review specialists/resources.md and analytics/DEV-README.md (both under refdir), plus the cass-persistence-compat lens notes in analytics-standards.md. I checked Marker, CdcState, Kryo and Avro (no serialized form or version change), IO and crash safety, and logging and metrics (no new failure path or metric). Result.isFullyRead() is still gated on log.completed(), so jumping position to maxOffset on a live segment cannot advance to the next log early. There is only one BufferingCommitLogReader copy (four-zero bridge), so no copy-forward bridge is missed. One low-confidence concern remains: the short-tail termination path. Files not reviewed: nothing. Tests were not run.

findings.title: Advance position when a section ends via the short-tail termination
findings.rule: Persisted CDC resume position and crash-safe progress (CdcState/Marker resume)
findings.problem: The new guard `if (statusTracker.shouldContinue())` skips updating position whenever readSection called requestTermination(). That is correct for the end-of-segment marker, which now sets maxOffset itself. The other benign termination, `end - reader.getFilePointer() < 4` at about line 436, sets no position. If a section ends with fewer than 4 trailing bytes (the 2.1-era case the code comment describes), the mutations of that section are emitted but position stays at the previous value. The listener emits the stale marker and the loop breaks, so later sections are never read. Result.isFullyRead() stays false and the next microbatch re-reads the same section. This is the same stall the ticket describes and produces duplicate mutations. Before the patch, position still advanced to reader.getFilePointer() on this path.
findings.fix: On that short-tail branch, set `this.position = (int) reader.getFilePointer()` (or the section end) before requestTermination(), or make the guard distinguish benign termination from error termination.
